name: Balast token list
comment: Real logos for the tokens that matter, in the Uniswap token-list shape.
Robinhood Chain has no public token list, so waiting for one means no
token ever gets a real logo. Add entries here and the indexer picks them
up on its next pass; a token that is not listed keeps the mark derived
from its address, which is unique and stable rather than blank.
Point the indexer at this file:  TOKEN_LIST_URL=config/tokens.json
Switch to a public list later:   TOKEN_LIST_URL=https://.../list.json
ONLY logoURI is read. Not price, not supply, and not decimals — decimals
are an input to every price, so they stay an on-chain read (CLAUDE.md §4:
logos and token metadata may come from external sources, numbers may not).
logoURI must be https and should be a square image, 64px or larger.
